visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a finished dish: braised chicken wings and chestnuts. The food is glossy with a dark brown glaze, garnished with chopped green onions. The background is a warm yellow wooden surface. (2) Hands wearing translucent plastic gloves are shown in a glass bowl, cutting raw chicken wings in half. Various seasonings like sesame oil, white pepper, and salt are added from small glass bowls and mixed by hand. (3) A black speckled non-stick pan is heated with a thin layer of oil. The seasoned chicken wings are poured in and stirred with a red and black silicone spatula until they start to brown. (4) Peeled yellow chestnuts are added to the pan and stir-fried together with the chicken. The camera focuses on the changing texture and color of the ingredients as they cook. (5) Chunks of white rock sugar are added and stirred until melted, coating the chicken and chestnuts in a caramel-like sheen. Then, soy sauce, oyster sauce, dried chilies, and whole spices are added. (6) Water is poured in to cover the ingredients, and a blue-rimmed glass lid is placed on the pan. The video cuts to the lid being removed, revealing a thickened, bubbling sauce and fully cooked meat. (7) The final dish is plated beautifully. The camera pans over the glistening chicken and soft chestnuts, emphasizing the appetizing texture and rich colors under bright studio lighting.

The BGM remains steady while the narrator provides instructions on frying to achieve a golden-brown color. (4) The sharp, percussive sound of peeled chestnuts hitting the pan occurs. The vocal delivery remains enthusiastic, specifying ingredient weights clearly over the continuous sizzling floor. (5) A rattling clink of rock sugar hitting the pan is followed by a splashing sound of liquid seasonings. The narrator lists spices like star anise and bay leaf with rhythmic pacing. (6) A sudden splash sound of water being added is followed by the mechanical click of a lid closing. The audio atmosphere shifts slightly to a muffled simmer while the voice continues.
